Statement: In a committed batch of up to 16 transfers, every fee is at most the policy rate and the totals are as stated: fees[i] * 10000 <= amounts[i] * max_fee_bps for every i, sum(amounts) == total_volume, sum(fees) == total_fees.

max_fee_bps.description: Fee cap per transfer in basis points. The verifier refuses a proof whose cap is looser than the registry policy.

window_ref.description: Non-zero reference to the attested window and batch.

total_volume.description: Sum of the batch amounts, in the smallest unit.

total_fees.description: Sum of the batch fees, in the smallest unit.

amounts.description: Transfer amounts; unused slots are zero.

fees.description: Fee charged on each transfer; unused slots are zero.

salt.description: Random blinding value for the batch commitment.

batch_commitment.description: Poseidon2(DOMAIN, window_ref, salt, amounts[0], fees[0], ...). Lets the batch be opened to an auditor later.

Limits: Covers up to 16 transfers per proof; a larger window takes several proofs, each with its own window_ref.
